note_company: Wolt (food/goods delivery, Helsinki-based, owned by DoorDash)
freshness_caveat: 0 resolved reports on HackerOne (listed 2026-07-27, ~5 days old) BUT the policy carries a 'Legacy Hall of Fame' of ~100 researchers who previously reported on Intigriti. So this is NOT a virgin program -- the H1 listing is new, the target has been hunted for years elsewhere. Adjust expectations accordingly.
exact_urls_high_value: authentication.wolt.com -- OAuth2/OIDC/JWT, signs JWTs that grant access to other services (CROWN JEWEL)
corporate.wolt.com -- admin portal for corporate customers, regular-user JWT should grant limited access
drive.wolt.com -- admin portal for last-mile delivery partners
ops.wolt.com -- EMPLOYEE-ONLY endpoints, policy explicitly says 'if you can show otherwise that'll be very interesting'
restaurant-api.wolt.com -- core API: create/edit users, place/track orders, set prices
mobile_apps: GOOGLE_PLAY com.wolt.courierapp -- COURIER app (no courier accounts available -- policy: 'very interesting if you can interact with courier APIs without a courier account')
excluded_not_submission_eligible: blog.wolt.com (third-party wpengine WordPress -- WordPress-level probes only, but not submission-eligible)
excluded_vuln_classes: Leaked human credentials from third-party datasets
ANY interaction with Customer Support staff (humans -- forbidden)
Network DoS/DDoS, Web Cache Poisoned DoS
Attacks requiring access to victim's device
API key disclosure without proven business impact
Signup with unverified mobile numbers (UNLESS you took over an existing number -- that IS a finding)
Verbose messages/dir listings without sensitive info
HTTP request smuggling without proven impact
Subdomain takeover WITHOUT proof (WITH proof IS in scope -- always verify via CNAME)
Host header injection without proven business impact

Mobile: clipboard link leakage, malicious-app-preinstall attacks, TLS-protected data in URLs, lack of obfuscation, path disclosure, missing jailbreak/root detection, malformed URL scheme crashes, missing anti-debug/SSL-pinning, snapshot/pasteboard leakage, jailbreak-only runtime exploits
policy_notes: Public program, no confidentiality clause (standard responsible disclosure) -> tracked in memory/.
MUST add 'X-HackerOne-Research: [H1 username]' header to ALL requests -- testing without it can forfeit the bounty.

Test entities provided: consumer test account user_id=670fa3e9ead6e49d65cc3614, venue test venue_id=670e7897e3c56dcc5b5a0989. Only interact with THESE / your own accounts -- never real restaurants/venues/merchants/users.

Self-registration IS allowed by the program, but our standing rule = no account creation by the agent. This limits authenticated testing (corporate/drive/merchant admin JWT-access angles need an account). Focus on unauthenticated angles.

BEST unauthenticated-compatible angles given no-account constraint: (1) courier API access without a courier account -- extract endpoints from com.wolt.courierapp APK, probe unauthenticated; (2) ops.wolt.com employee-only endpoints reachable externally; (3) standard recon: takeover-with-proof, private-IP DNS sweep, cloud_enum, JS secret/config exposure.
Keep reports 300-400 words per program request.
